claims.text: NEAR captures a growing share of fees, feeding buybacks that permanently remove NEAR from circulation.
claims.data: The NEAR sits in buybacks.multisignature.near (2,024,302 NEAR), a multisig whose signers can move it; 3 outflows have moved 12,025 NEAR so far, and total supply rose in 42 of 42 sampled intervals. It is out of circulation only while the signers keep it there; the chain does not make that permanent.

claims.text: NearBlocks shows 2,015,496 NEAR in buybacks.multisignature.near while revenue.near.org lists 1,510,411 NEAR, and nothing published explains the difference.
claims.data: Both numbers are right. NearBlocks shows the wallet's balance; the dashboard shows the revenue it received from outside, up to 2026-10-17. The 505,086 NEAR gap is 510,068 NEAR moved in from the other revenue wallet, minus 12,025 NEAR sent out, plus 7,043 NEAR of revenue after that date; it closes to -0.026 NEAR (F2f).

claims.who: SVRN x The Tie, NEAR Protocol report
claims.text: Buybacks would match issuance (the report's "deflation threshold") at about $177M of daily Intents volume, with issuance of 32.2M NEAR a year worth about $39.3M.
claims.data: The figure is in dollars, so it moves with the NEAR price. The report's own numbers imply $1.22 a NEAR; at today's $4.67 the same inputs give about $677M a day, against our $795M. And "deflation" there means purchases match issuance; the NEAR is held, so supply does not fall.
claims.verdict: Dated: close to ours once repriced

claims.text: Buybacks would offset issuance at about $1.13B of daily Intents volume, at a NEAR price of $5.90 and a net take of about 4.6 bps.
claims.data: Our formula with their price and take gives $1.12B a day. The gap to our $795M is the inputs: price $5.90 against $4.67, take 4.6 against 5.15 bps.

claims.text: The chain issues about 90K new NEAR a day, against about $30M a year of fee capture.
claims.data: Net issuance is 87,677 NEAR a day over the last 28 days (the 2.5% cap mints a little more; fee burn takes the rest). Captured revenue ran at $28.0M a year over the last 30 days.

claims.who: SVRN's CEO on Bankless, reported by Stocktwits
claims.text: Buybacks are still real, but issuance runs six times higher.
claims.data: New supply was 5.8x the NEAR the three revenue wallets took in over 28 days, or 8.4x counting only the 69% of revenue that reached the buyback wallet (F2c).

claims.who: Bitwise (Ryan Rasmussen), reported by Crypto Briefing
claims.text: Buybacks are not yet enough to offset new issuance.
claims.data: Buybacks would match issuance only at 5.3x today's Intents volume, and only if the NEAR were burned (F4a).

claims.text: Realised issuance is about 2.45% a year, and the treasury receives about 10.13% of supply growth.
claims.data: 7d: 10.207%, 28d: 10.180%, 92d: 10.147% vs published 10.13%; 28d net issuance 87,677 NEAR/day = 2.444%/yr vs published 2.45% (F3a, F3b).
